Frequently Asked Questions
How am I charged?


Billing is paid by your team and is based on how many users you purchase.


How many mail accounts can I send from?


With each user you pay for, your team may connect 1 mail account. So you might choose to pay for 3 users but only have 1 person on your team so that you can connect 3 mail accounts.


What mail accounts does Mailshake work with?


Mailshake works with Gmail, G Suite, Office 365, most Outlook and Exchange accounts, and most any email address that supports SMTP and IMAP connections.


How am I charged if I change my subscription in the middle of my billing cycle?


Your costs will be prorated, so you will either have a pending charge or credit on your account. Learn more here .


Is there a free trial?


No, we collect payment up front, however, we offer concierge onboarding, deliverability training, and support resources to help you be successful.


Can I cancel any time?


Yes, as long as you cancel your plan before its renewal date you won‘t be charged again (unless you have outstanding charges such as pending prorated costs from changing your subscription).


Does Mailshake work for agencies?


Yes! We recommend having your client create their own team so they are the billed party and add you as a user on their team. You can belong to as many teams as you like and it‘s easy to switch between teams. Unless you have your own team, you will not be billed.

Cold Email Deliverability






Email Deliverability Tools Included with Every Plan
Mailshake deeply understands email deliverability best practices so every plan includes built-in tools that check email deliverability so your cold outreach lands in the inbox—not in spam.


Email Warm Up
Warm up your email domain with Mailshake’s email warm up tool to improve your sender score and stay off email black lists.


Connect your new or existing email account (via SMTP)

Configure daily sending volume to start email warm up

Our warm up tool automatically takes actions such as opening, replying, and removing from spam

Analyze your spam score to make sure you keep landing in the inbox



Ready to Use Mailboxes Within Mailshake
Mailshake’s mailboxes feature spreads your outreach across several mailboxes to ensure optimal deliverability. Skip the setup hassle with Mailshake and add a domain with 5 ready to use mailboxes.


Scale your email infrastructure by automatically creating dozens of email addresses.

Mailshake handles the behind-the-scenes — SPF, MX, and DKIM records are already set up for you.

Auto-rotate mailboxes to stay under sending limits & stay out of the spam folder.


Email Validation
Email validation credits included with every plan removes bad email addresses, which is crucial to maintaining a good email sender score


Classifies each email address based on its bounce risk

Removes email addresses with high bounce or spam honey pots that could cause deliverability issues

Monthly credits included to maintain a clean email list



Use Multiple Sending Email Addresses
Email rotation allows you to use multiple email addresses within a single campaign. Using email rotation within Mailshake improves deliverability and allows you to send a higher number of emails daily.



Frequently Asked Questions
What is meant by email deliverability?


Email deliverability is the ability of an email to reach the intended recipient's inbox. It's determined by a variety of factors, including the sender's reputation, the content of the email, and the recipient's spam filtering settings.

Mailshake is designed to help you improve your email deliverability. Our platform analyzes your email lists and provides feedback on how to improve your deliverability.


Why is email deliverability so important?


Email deliverability is so important because if your email doesn't reach the inbox, it's unlikely that your recipient will ever see it, potentially resulting in lost opportunities. By using Mailshake, you can increase your chances of reaching the inbox by analyzing your spam score to make sure your emails are hitting your intended recipients’ inboxes.


What does the email deliverability tool do?


Mailshake's email deliverability tool monitors your open and click rates, blacklisting statuses, and bounces to help you identify and fix any issues that may be preventing your emails from being delivered. It also includes a spam score analysis to help you make sure your emails aren't getting flagged as spam.


How do I Improve my email deliverability?


If you're having trouble getting your emails delivered, Mailshake can help. With Mailshake, you can improve your email deliverability and make sure your messages get through to your contacts. With Mailshake, you can:


Monitor your email deliverability in real time

Get insights into what's causing delivery problems

Fix delivery issues with just a few clicks

Improve your sender reputation



Which email deliverability tool is the best?


Mailshake's email deliverability tool is the best in the business. We use a variety of methods to ensure your emails reach the inbox, including DKIM and SPF authentication, as well as email validation credits allowing you to maintain a good email sender score so that your emails are less likely to end up in the spam folder.

Mailshake Powers Your Mail Merge






Easily add your list of prospects
Save time by uploading your list of contacts to Mailshake in seconds
Creating a mail merge allows you to easily send one customized email to an entire group of contacts at the same time.

In Mailshake, you can manually add recipients to a campaign one-by-one, or all at once by uploading a CSV file that contains all recipients and associated column data.

The benefit of mail merges is that they show up in inboxes as 1-1 emails, as opposed to other types of automated email marketing campaigns.


Personalize every email to your prospects
Boost reply rates with emails automatically personalized for each recipient
Mail merge allows you to streamline your cold outreach efforts while keeping the authenticity and personalization of your email correspondence intact.

In Mailshake, you can insert field replacement tags in order to pull in relevant data (first name, company name, etc) for each recipient that you intend to email. You also have to ability to manually add more personalization to each recipient’s email before you push your campaign live.


Automate your entire outreach workflow
Increase success by scheduling delivery and automating follow-ups
With Mailshake, you can increase open rates, reply rates, and overall success by scheduling your emails to deliver on a day or time of day that you think will work best for your recipients.

You can also drive more engagement with the people you send cold emails to by adding follow-up emails to your campaign. These follow-ups are triggered and automatically sent to recipients based on specific criteria that you can customize when building your campaign.


Powerful integrations for your mail merge
Use your existing tools to manage leads
A native integration with Salesforce and Hubspot allows you to stay on top of all of your contacts automatically...

...and through the power of Zapier, you can hook up just about anything to Mailshake. Create a Google Form that sends Mailshake campaigns, send Mailshake leads into any tool, and much more.



Frequently Asked Questions
What is a mail merge?


A mail merge is a process of sending out mass emails that are personalized for each recipient. This can be done with a spreadsheet of data, or by pulling in information from a database. Mailshake makes it easy to personalize your messages with dynamic content, so you can create custom emails for each contact.


What does the mail merge feature do?


Mailshake's mail merge feature enables you to send personalized emails to a large number of recipients simultaneously. With mail merge, you can create a custom email for each recipient, ensuring that each message is tailored to that individual's needs.


What would I use mail merge for?


Mail merge is a great way to personalize your email outreach. With mail merge, you can also create custom email content for each individual recipient, making your sales & email marketing campaigns more personalized and effective.


Which mail merge software is the best?


Mailshake is the best mail merge software because it's easy to use and helps you create powerful, personalized email campaigns. With Mailshake, you can easily create custom email content, personalize your messages, and track your results.
